name: LVOS (large-scale)
description: A large-scale benchmark for long-term video object segmentation designed to evaluate segmentation and tracking performance over extensive datasets and prolonged sequences.
evaluation_method: region similarity (J / IoU), contour accuracy (F), mean IoU, and tracking-oriented metrics (e.g., ID-F1) — often reported as mean J&F
general_score_metric: mean J&F (average of region similarity J and contour accuracy F)
reputation: Recognized in the video object segmentation community as a challenging long-term VOS benchmark and increasingly used for evaluating long-duration tracking/segmentation models.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on vision; long sequences increase computational cost and memory requirements; potential class/sequence length imbalance and annotation inconsistency across very long clips.
